goal: Generate a studio visual suitable to be used as an advertising-level single-page main image, with the product as the sole narrative center, creating a unified atmosphere with restrained tones.

subject.product_name: Ocean Blue Mystery Classic Essence Cream 60ml
subject.visual_description: Small round white porcelain wide-mouth jar, paired with a mint green semi-matte box lid, the jar body has a raised La Mer round embossed logo and small English, and the jar mouth shows soft peaks of rich cream
subject.position: Slightly to the right of the center, near the golden ratio.

background.type: Deep olive green and warm gold gradient in a deep studio backdrop
background.texture: Delicate Velvet Forms Soft Ripples in the Background, No Mixed Patterns
background.color_tone: Sea foam green, warm gold, ivory white, and deep moss green

lighting.key_light: Left front 45° main light, highlighting the facade of the ceramic jar and the rise and fall of text labels
lighting.fill_light: Weak soft light on the right side, suppressing the shadow to deep black
lighting.rim_light: Narrow gold edges behind, outlining the canister profile
lighting.mood: Warm, quietly luxurious, like the last slanting light before dusk

items: Two small mother-of-pearl slices in the same color scheme.
A half-exposed golden small scoop lying horizontally beside the jar
props.rule: Number of props ≤ 2, colors must match the main color.

text_overlay.headline: The sea begins here
text_overlay.position: In the upper third of the left side of the image, sufficient white space.

style.rendering: Top-grade commercial photography + high dynamic range + micro particles, looking like a full-page magazine advertisement
style.depth: Shallow depth of field, background velvet is slightly blurred.
style.consistency: The color palette is strictly unified, with no additional bright colors

must_keep: Product as the absolute main character
The direction of light is unified
The tones are unified and not cluttered
Copy does not obscure the main product.
avoid: Include hands, faces or life scenes
The green background merging with the product causes the outline to be unclear
